title: Sustainable antimicrobial formulations: vitamin-E based emulsions stabilized by plant-derived saponin from Acacia concinna
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,5073-5083
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08297D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wasefa Begum, Rajlakshmi Laha, Sk Mehebub Rahaman, Monohar Hossain Mondal, Somasri Dam, Bidyut Saha, Ujjwal Mandal
A stable oil-in-water emulsion was developed using vitamin-E and saponin from Acacia concinna. The emulsion exhibited significant antifungal activity against A. flavus and C. albicans, making it a promising natural and effective topical formulation.
